integrity: The mathematical proof and 40 finite computational checks are supplied. No external or independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to bi-infinite Sturmian binary decorations and infinite allowed-gap sets; it relies on classical Skolem–Mahler–Lech and Pólya–Carlson theorems. The related finite-code renewal paper was inspected only at abstract level, leaving historical-priority risk. Finite tests do not prove the universal conclusions.
title: Periodic zeta rationality versus Sturmian nonsoficity in decorated gap shifts
